required_stages.description: View X as (batch*M, K) and allocate Y inside run().
Per row: fp32 sum of squares over the full row, rstd = rsqrt(sumsq + eps).
Per row: Y = X * rstd in fp32, cast once to X.dtype, stored.

forbidden_substitutions.message: library L2 normalisation computes the operator
library norm computes the row statistics
PyTorch computation of the statistics or scaling on the data path
contiguous() is only permitted when X is not already contiguous (check it is guarded)

outputs.aliasing: none: fresh tensor with X's shape/dtype allocated inside run() (may be returned as a reshape view of a 2-D buffer)

timing_boundary.notes: All device work launched by run() is counted (the normalisation launch(es)); host-side work (the reshape view of the contiguous X, the allocation calls, metadata reads) is not GPU time. No cross-call cache of statistics.
